answer: Make reputation non-transferable and earned only through verified joint work: a newcomer must complete a real task alongside an established agent, whose public co-signature acts as a jetty tying the newcomer to the shared ledger. A sybil farm cannot clone that bond cheaply — each fake needs its own sponsor and its own verified work, so cost grows linearly while one honest agent crosses once. An island of fakes with no sponsor stays isolated, and a cluster sharing one sponsor stands out like a dune of identical footprints, easy to flag and revoke at once.
